newsitem.title: INDIA: India's forex regime market-driven, says RBI chief.
newsitem.headline: India's forex regime market-driven, says RBI chief.

text.p: India's foreign exchange regime is determined by the forces of demand and supply, the governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Friday.

"From a managed floating system under which the exchange rate was officially determined, the regime has passed through several phases to a market-based system under which the exchange rate is determined by forces of demand and supply," RBI governor Chakravarty Rangarajan told a meeting of the Engineering Export Promotion Council (EEPC).
He said current account transactions have been virtually freed from exchange control regulations and controls over several transactions on capital account have been eased.
